{
  "comments": [
    "5a56fbde: ;
;This routine contains helper functions for THGL*18.0*213, the Clinical Reminder
;Orders national release. The following helper functions are included:
;
;1) DGRENCR - This function gets all reminder resolution prompts for a given
;   reminder and puts them into ^TMP global.
;2) PARSE - This function parses the reminder resolution prompt response into its
;   components.
;3) PROCPARM - This function processes the reminder resolved reminder
;   parameters.
;4) CHKORP - This function checks if an order is present for the resolved
;   reminder parameter.
;5) RESORD - This function resolves/creates the order for a resolved reminder
;   parameter.
;6) CHKRSLT - This function checks reminder results for resolved reminders
;7) SETRSLT - This function sets reminder results for resolved reminders.
;8) OUTPUT - This function outputs the final results for a resolved reminder.",
    "d21146c6:  ;
 ;This routine contains text extracted from the HEALTH LITERACY field,
 ;which is free text input used for display in GUI/Web Client.
 ;",
    "5a6cd5c5:  ;
 ;Routine to display text for the help screens of the CIH application.
 ;",
    "c5cd45a0: ;
Sets up text for the help popup window containing text about the View Profile
private record field.
;",
    "0dc207ab:  ;
 ;This routine displays Help Text for AD/HL modules.
 ;",
    "aa62925d: ;Quit out of this routine."
  ]
}
